## Example 4.13 {#iv4-example-4-13 .vector-lesson .magnitude-lesson }

<p>Let <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}=3\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{j}-\underset{\sim}{k}"></span> and <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}=2\underset{\sim}{i}-\underset{\sim}{j}-3\underset{\sim}{k}"></span>. Find</p><div class="m-parts"><div class="m-part"><p><strong>a)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="3(2)+2(-1)+(-1)(-3)=7"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>b)</strong> <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{b}\cdot\underset{\sim}{a}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="2(3)+(-1)(2)+(-3)(-1)=7"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>c)</strong> <span data-math="\widehat{\underset{\sim}{a}}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{a}|=\sqrt{14}"></span></div><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="\widehat{\underset{\sim}{a}}=\frac{3\underset{\sim}{i}+2\underset{\sim}{j}-\underset{\sim}{k}}{\sqrt{14}}"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="m-part"><p><strong>d)</strong> <span data-math="\widehat{\underset{\sim}{a}}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}"></span></p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="m-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show working</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="m-equation"><span data-math="\frac{3(2)+2(-1)+(-1)(-3)}{\sqrt{14}}=\frac7{\sqrt{14}}"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 4.13 · p. 34</div>

::: notes
a) 7; b) 7; c) (3,2,−1)/sqrt(14); d) 7/sqrt(14)=sqrt(14)/2. For d, substitute the unit-vector components directly. Note the equal results in a and b without introducing an extended algebraic-properties proof lesson.
:::
